$comment: Realms product sheet (Product section only). realms seed deploys this onto **Realms GOS Casals** — never GaaS Casals, never as a union with gos-as-a-service/casals.json. The conductor's own Casals/System canisters (casals-backend, casals-frontend, Casals file-registry) are deliberately NOT declared here; Casals protects them from sheet-driven reinstall. Do not add them to this sheet. Fleet file-registry lives only here (not on GaaS Infra). marketplace-frontend is DNS keep-ID (*.realmsgos.org): adopt/reinstall on the same principal; do not delete_canister. Default seed adopts existing ids; --rebuild destroys non-DNS product canisters. No per-stand batons (realm stands + GaaS infra-baton). Token/NFT backends ic-tokens v0.1.0; frontends empty certified-assets. Demo realm stands: casals-config/sheets/realms.json.
